title: Convergence of the original BGN method for mean curvature flow
summary: We prove that the original Barrett--Garcke--Nürnberg (BGN) method for mean curvature flow of curves converges in the manifold distance with order $h^2$ for the time step $τ=h^2$. The key new technique is backward error analysis, which stems from the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equations. By combining the expansions of the discrete velocity in space and time, we construct an approximation flow whose interpolation satisfies the BGN method with an improved defect, of order $h^4$ with tangential part of order $h^6$.
